massage_qps_stats_counters: extract core stats counters from gRPC QPS scenario results into flat BigQuery-compatible fields
massage_qps_stats_histograms: extract histogram data from gRPC core stats and compute 50th, 95th, and 99th percentile values
massage_qps_stats_http2_ops: extract HTTP/2 operation counters like send message, recv message, and settings writes from core stats
massage_qps_stats_syscalls: extract syscall counters including poll, wait, epoll_ctl, read, and write from gRPC core stats
massage_qps_stats_hpack: extract HPACK compression counters for indexed, literal, and Huffman-encoded headers from core stats
